unfinished: Dialogue windows were estimated with local faster-whisper small on the English source after ffmpeg decoding; ASR timestamps are approximate.
Visual review used contact sheets sampled every 0.5 to 3 seconds plus selected full-size frames, not frame-by-frame annotation.
A local Mandarin ASR pass roughly recovered the narration but made homophone substitutions; it is not a reliable judgment of pronunciation or naturalness.
ASR does not identify key nonverbal effects, and there was no independent subjective listening review; possible brief effect masking remains uncertain.
omissions: No narration is placed over the discovery or campsite conversations because the dialogue already conveys the reactions and intentions.
Small background movements are omitted where describing them would add detail without clarifying the main movement or reveal.
